name: reasoning
description: A collapsible component for displaying AI reasoning steps and chain-of-thought processes
designIntent: The Reasoning component displays the step-by-step thought process of an AI agent. It's collapsible to avoid cluttering the interface while still providing transparency into how the AI arrived at its conclusions.

props.name: steps
props.description: Array of reasoning steps to display
examples: [{ id: '1', content: 'Analyzing the request...' }, { id: '2', content: 'Formulating response...' }]

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Whether the reasoning can be collapsed/expanded

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the reasoning is expanded by default

props.name: duration
props.description: Elapsed reasoning time in seconds; renders a duration chip

props.name: isStreaming
props.description: Shows a streaming indicator while reasoning is in progress

examples.title: Basic reasoning
examples.code:
<Reasoning 
  steps={[
    { id: '1', content: 'I need to analyze the user\'s request.' },
    { id: '2', content: 'The user wants to know about React components.' },
    { id: '3', content: 'I should provide a comprehensive answer.' }
  ]}
/>

examples.title: With timestamps
examples.code:
<Reasoning 
  steps={[
    { id: '1', content: 'Step 1', timestamp: new Date() },
    { id: '2', content: 'Step 2', timestamp: new Date() }
  ]}
/>

antiPatterns.title: Don't show reasoning for simple responses
antiPatterns.explanation: Reasoning is valuable for complex tasks but adds noise for simple responses.

antiPatterns.title: Don't make steps too verbose
antiPatterns.explanation: Reasoning steps should be concise and focused on key decision points.

antiPatterns.title: Don't show empty reasoning
antiPatterns.explanation: The component returns null for empty arrays, but it's better to not render it at all.

accessibility.implementation: Uses aria-expanded to communicate collapsible state to screen readers
accessibility.userRequirements: Ensure the expanded/collapsed state is clear to all users

accessibility.implementation: Collapsible button is keyboard accessible with Enter/Space to toggle
accessibility.userRequirements: Test keyboard navigation of the collapse/expand functionality

accessibility.implementation: Steps are numbered and visually distinct with clear hierarchy
accessibility.userRequirements: Ensure step numbers and content have sufficient contrast

guidelines: Each step should represent a distinct decision or action
Focus on the 'why' and 'how', not just the 'what'
Avoid overly technical jargon unless necessary
goodExamples: Analyzing the user's request for key requirements
Considering multiple approaches to solve the problem
Selecting the most efficient solution based on constraints
badExamples: I am thinking about what to do

guidelines: Show the total number of steps in the header
Number each step sequentially for easy reference
Keep step count reasonable (typically under 10 steps)
If there are many steps, consider grouping them

compositionRules.relationship: Reasoning is typically displayed before or within an assistant's message to show thought process
compositionRules.example: Message component can contain Reasoning to show the AI's thinking before the final response

compositionRules.relationship: Reasoning often precedes tool calls to explain why a tool is being used
compositionRules.example: Reasoning explains the decision to use a tool, ToolCall shows the actual tool invocation
